title: Repin the Cyclotron engine and web package to their releases
description:
Pin the Python extra to Cyclotron main b2234be (the ui-v0.2.1 tag's commit) and the web package to the ui-v0.2.1 release tarball, then remove the References tab's browser-only rendering of the review control: ui-v0.2.1 derives the control's field ids from the item and decision, so server and client renders agree.

Done when: pyproject and poetry.lock pin b2234be; package.json and the lockfile pin cyclotron-0.2.1.tgz; ReferenceRelevanceReview renders on the server; the References tab scenarios pass with no hydration error.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Repinned on chore/PPY-70d9fd-cyclotron-repin: pyproject/poetry.lock to Cyclotron b2234be (ui-v0.2.1's commit), package.json/package-lock to cyclotron-0.2.1.tgz; ReferenceRelevanceReview renders on the server again (browser-only gate removed). Verified: features/newsroom-reference-relevance.feature 4/4 twice against next dev in demo mode with no hydration error; test:relevance-review-ui asserts server-rendered ids come from item and decision; backend cyclotron scenarios 22/22; typecheck and eslint clean.

right_now_summary: Cyclotron dependencies are pinned, server rendering is restored, and all tests pass without hydration errors.
